SCOTUS took a giant step in the right direction today by not upholding Biden’s oppressive vaccine mandate for large employers. 

Now it’s time to finish the job and prevent this socialistic government from imposing its will on health care workers, federal workers & our military.

Glad to see this is moving in the right direction. 

Hopefully we’ll see the same for our U.S. military members and health care workers soon. https://t.co/YduVJGKAL6

🎙 Thanks for having me on @DanMandisShow!

Fentanyl related deaths is a public health emergency exasperated by an open border.

We must give border patrol agents every resource available to expedite the expulsion of illegal migrants. 

📻 Listen here ⤵️
https://t.co/7vNequXE7w

Our focus should be on hardening schools and increasing mental health services access.

I voted no on both H.R. 7910 and H.R. 2377 because I believe in protecting our constitutional rights. (2/2)

For the 4th month in a row migrant encounters at the southern border have topped 200,000.

My bill H.R. 7359 gives law enforcement the ability to immediately expel illegal aliens due to the Fentanyl public health threat. CBP should have every tool available to combat this crisis. https://t.co/Npgg7nwWwZ

The reconciliation bill endangers patient access to care by:

🩺Government price control setting leading to lack of innovation & provider care
🩺Not addressing Medicare provider payment cuts beginning in 2023
🩺Robbing Medicare to pay insurance subsidies & non-health expenditures

Fentanyl is the leading killer of Americans age 18-45. Stopping this public health crisis starts with securing our southern border.

That’s why I introduced the Stop Fentanyl Border Crossings Act.
https://t.co/JIDXPPIKHw

Today, the CDC voted to add the COVID vaccine to the recommended vaccination schedule (which is required by most public schools). Thanks to our Tennessee State Legislature, parents will be rightfully in charge of healthcare decisions for their children. (1/2)

Our southern border is open. The end of Title 42 will threaten the safety of every American. 

That’s why I introduced H.R. 7359. A bill that uses Title 42 protections to expel illegal migrants due to the public health crisis posed by fentanyl. https://t.co/XqPqLTjFIy

Great day in Giles County!

Had the opportunity to meet with County Executive Graham Stowe at the Soda Pop Junction & Chancellor Dr. Linda Martin at @UT_Southern. She introduced me to some nursing students who are learning the ins and outs of practicing rural medicine! https://t.co/g0hlYSNrxq

Had the opportunity to join the @mattmurphyshow on @997wtn to discuss my new legislation to make proof of cognitive health a requirement for Presidential and Vice-Presidential candidates.

🎙️Listen here ⤵️
https://t.co/LkaVZZWze0

Amy and I are praying for the friends and family members of the five Fort Campbell soldiers who lost their lives during a Black Hawk helicopter exercise. 

May we never forget their service and sacrifice for our great Nation.

Bidenflation is a tax on ALL Americans.

🚘 Motor vehicle insurance is UP 20.3%
🍼 Baby food and formula are UP 7.3%
🏠 Rent is UP 6.5%

This is why we need to curb wasteful government spending, cut regulatory red tape & make the US energy independent.

https://t.co/pBFP252pWn

Amy and I are praying for the recovery of Kyler Trice & his family, a Shelbyville Central High School basketball player, who collapsed during a game last week. Thank you for the quick response from his coaches & school admins during this medical emergency.https://t.co/tPxtvZDliY

Great to have @tnhospitals in the office yesterday! I appreciate the update on issues impacting hospitals in #TN04 and how we can work together to provide the best care for our district. https://t.co/jZKtGGr3ft

The White House now appears to flip flop and say they do have the authority to take action at the border. 

The problem is their solution now appears to be the equivalent of an usher allowing people into the theater while pushing a tally counter clicker.

It is no secret the President Biden’s health has been in decline for quite some time. I am glad to see that he has made the best choice for himself, his family, and for the country.

President Biden is going to have to come out and tell the American people why he has decided not to run. 

If it’s because of his health or mental decline he must immediately resign.

My thoughts with @DanMandisShow on @997wtn 👇 https://t.co/XXGdsDsTu3

Biden left the American people tonight with more questions than answers. His abrupt exit from the race is either because his party convinced him he couldn’t win or his health and cognition is such that he should no longer be president—and I don’t think they’re mutually exclusive.

Tennessee is leading the Nation and taking the fight to #SCOTUS to protect confused minors from predatory doctors pushing them into receiving life-altering medical mutilation. 

Thank you to our state leaders for fighting to keep our children safe.

https://t.co/VPjnNmP4Yu

The far-Left media coverage of the L.A. riots has been absolutely laughable.

I applaud President Trump’s swift response to the ongoing unrest and hope that these destructive protests end soon. 

My thoughts on the @mattmurphyshow on @997wtn 👇 https://t.co/EvAzGV1Q2q

Grateful for the time I got to spend with the residents and staff at @NHC Healthcare Sequatchie! The attentiveness these amazing healthcare providers give to the patients here is second to none. 

I am proud to have this award winning facility known for its cleanliness and care right here in #TN04!

Happy Labor Day to all of the hardworking people of #TN04! American workers are the backbone of ensuring we have a secure supply chain, safe communities, access to healthcare and so much more. Thank you for all you do to better your communities! https://t.co/O0DSyt1QfF
